place.name: Andros, Greece
place.description: Andros (Greek: Άνδρος, pronounced [ˈanðros]) is the northernmost island of the Cyclades archipelago in Greece, about 10 km (6 mi) southeast of Euboea, and about 3 km (2 mi) north of Tinos. It is nearly 40 km (25 mi) long, and its greatest breadth is 16 km (10 mi).
